# Release Notes Template — Companion Resources

Downloadable files for the [Release Notes Template](https://stackpractices.com/docs/release-notes-template/) article.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `release-notes-template.md` | Blank release note skeleton with all sections |
| `release-notes-example.md` | Fully worked v2.5.0 example (breaking change, CVE, metrics) |
| `hotfix-template.md` | Short format for emergency releases |
| `commit-to-note-mapping.md` | Conventional commit prefix → release note section cheat sheet |

## How to use

1. Copy `release-notes-template.md` into your repo or docs site.
2. Keep only the sections that apply to your release — prune, don't fill.
3. Use `commit-to-note-mapping.md` to sort commits into sections.
4. For emergency releases, use `hotfix-template.md` instead.

Spanish version: [Plantilla de Release Notes](https://stackpractices.com/es/docs/release-notes-template/)
